_comment: Shipped price table (D12). Rates are USD per million tokens, one entry
per model identifier under 'models'; 'aliases' maps a short name to the
full identifier it resolves to -- a lookup, not a prefix match, because
which alias points at which version is data, not a rule.
Key names match usage_collector.TOKEN_KEYS verbatim so a caller can
multiply token_count * price[same_key] without a translation layer.
different rates (1.25x and 2x base input) -- mixing them up silently
reprices every cache write by up to 48%, see the implementation-notes
<synthetic> is priced at 0, not unpriced: those records are Claude
Code's own notification messages (e.g. 'Please run /login'), not API
calls -- all five token counts measure zero. Giving it a real price row
keeps 'unpriced' meaning only 'this model is not in the table' (D12).
(fetched first-hand in the main session on 'version' below).
